sloka: मत्तप्रमत्तानि समाकुलानि ।तथाश्वभद्रासनसम्कुलानि ।वीरः श्रिया चापि समाकुलानि ।ददर्श धीमान् स कपिः कुलानि ॥५-५-१०॥
transliteration: mattapramattāni samākulāni ।tathāśvabhadrāsanasamkulāni ।vīraḥ śriyā cāpi samākulāni ।dadarśa dhīmān sa kapiḥ kulāni ॥5-5-10॥

translations.english: Intelligent Hanuman, the great warrior, observed there in the prosperous mansions, demons proud of their wealth, highly intoxicated and dull, their houses full of horsedrawn chariots with comfortable seats.
